title: Go agent on the Anthropic API
summary: A hand-written tool loop on anthropic-sdk-go behind a small Model interface, an approval gate before side-effecting tools, a turn limit, and OpenTelemetry (the SDK emits a span per request).
verified: RUN: go vet and go test passed here and the gold set ran against the offline stub with Go 1.26 and anthropic-sdk-go 1.84.0. The live Messages API path compiled against the SDK; no live model call was made here. 1.3.0: runs that wait for a person kept in SQLite (modernc.org/sqlite, pure Go) and answered from another process, the refund made once after a crash, and the HTTP interface with OIDC token checks, all in its tests and gold set.
stack_line: A Go agent on the Anthropic API (anthropic-sdk-go 1.84). There is no official Claude Agent SDK for Go, so the loop is explicit.
run_cmd: go run ./cmd/agent "Where is my order ORD-1001?"
next: Replace the get_order body and payments in internal/agent/tools.go with calls to your systems; pass the idempotency key to the system that makes the change.
Rewrite evals/gold.jsonl for your use case; keep the safety and gate tags.
Set AGENT_IDENTITY=oidc (or proxy) and the AGENT_OIDC_* settings before the HTTP interface is reachable by anyone; demo identities are refused in production.

ai_act.purpose: Answers customers' questions about their orders and requests refunds; a person approves every refund before it is issued.
notice: You're chatting with an AI assistant, not a person.
